The seventh beta of Spine 1.0. Spine's repository starts afresh: the source is the same as 1.0.0-beta.6, with a small fix and a public roadmap.

## Before you upgrade

- Nothing to change. `./upgrade.sh --version 1.0.0-beta.7` backs up first, as always. On a Docker panel, set `SPINE_VERSION=1.0.0-beta.7` (or paste this release's `docker-compose.panels.yml`) and redeploy; on Coolify, paste this release's `docker-compose.coolify.yml`.
- Earlier betas are no longer listed on GitHub. Their images stay on `ghcr.io`, so an install on an earlier beta keeps running, and `upgrade.sh` takes it straight to this one.

## New

- **Roadmap:** [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/haribrothers/spine/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) lists what's planned after 1.0, and what stays out of Spine.

## Fixed

- **Editing an invoice or a vendor bill:** the line under the page title now says what can still happen to the document: an issued invoice can only be voided or credited, and a recorded bill can only be voided.

The full list is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/haribrothers/spine/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
